fact: The South Sudan Revenue Authority Commissioner General directed on 2026-03-13 that all government revenues be paid exclusively through the National e-Tax System, banning manual collection with immediate effect, with electronic receipts as proof of payment.

FreeBalance's press release says South Sudan's Ministry of Finance and Planning is expanding its existing IFMIS to additional ministries, departments and agencies, under a contract signed in Juba on 4 February 2025.
